name: Instrument Library
description: A compendium of single reference instruments, all built from the synthesized kit: keyboards, mallets and bells, plucked and bowed strings, woodwinds, brass, free reeds and pipes, voices, percussion and classic synthesizers. Every sketch defines its instrument once as a patch function at the top, then plays a short reference phrase chosen to show it off. Copy the const line into any sketch and call it as a method, for example note("c4 e4 g4").grand().
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Grand Piano
sketches.description: A soft hammered string with a long, falling decay. Reference: a C major scale up and down, a broken chord and block chords over the roots.

sketches.name: Electric Piano
sketches.description: Two-operator FM at ratio 2 with a gentle tremolo: the classic tine sound. Reference: four seventh chords and a melody over them.

sketches.name: Harpsichord
sketches.description: A narrow pulse plucked short inside a wooden case. Reference: a baroque figure in D over a walking bass.

sketches.name: Pipe Organ
sketches.description: An organ-voiced saw that speaks quickly and holds for as long as the key is down, in a church. Reference: a four-chord chorale on the manual with the pedal below.

sketches.name: Vibraphone
sketches.description: FM bars with a long ring and a motor tremolo. Reference: a pentatonic run, a broken chord, ringing dyads and a falling line in F.

sketches.name: Marimba
sketches.description: A short, woody FM strike over resonator tubes. Reference: an interlocking pattern across two octaves in G, with low bars on the bass notes.

sketches.name: Glockenspiel
sketches.description: Small steel bars: bright, inharmonic FM with a quick fade. Reference: a simple tune high up in C.

sketches.name: Tubular Bells
sketches.description: Long brass tubes: FM at the bell ratio 2.76, ringing for seconds in a hall. Reference: four bells rung in different orders.

sketches.name: Steel Pan
sketches.description: A hammered steel note: close FM with a peak where the pan sings. Reference: a calypso phrase in C ending on rolled long notes.

sketches.name: Kalimba
sketches.description: A plucked metal tine over a small wooden box. Reference: alternating thumbs over the tines in G.

sketches.name: Nylon Guitar
sketches.description: A soft pluck inside a guitar body. Reference: fingerpicking through Am, Dm and E, ending on a strummed chord.

sketches.name: Overdriven Guitar
sketches.description: A saw driven into a tube curve and out of a combo cabinet. Reference: power chords, then a single-note riff in E.

sketches.name: Banjo
sketches.description: A bright, short pluck on a drumhead; the can body gives the twang. Reference: a forward roll through G, C, D and G.

sketches.name: Concert Harp
sketches.description: A soft pluck with a long, warm ring. Reference: a glissando up and down in E-flat, then rolled chords.

sketches.name: Koto
sketches.description: A bright, dry pluck on a long wooden box. Reference: up and down the hirajoshi scale, then a phrase that settles on the root.

sketches.name: Sitar
sketches.description: A bright saw with a tiny pitch kick on every pluck, sliding between notes. Reference: rising and falling phrases in C lydian, the colour of raga Yaman.

sketches.name: Upright Bass
sketches.description: A round, plucked sine with a little grit and a woody body. Reference: a walking line through a ii-V-I-VI in F.

sketches.name: Violin
sketches.description: A bowed saw with a gentle vibrato in a violin body. Reference: a slow scale in A minor, then a singing phrase high on the E string.

sketches.name: Cello
sketches.description: The violin's body made twice as large: darker, slower to speak and lower. Reference: an open arpeggio and a phrase in C.

sketches.name: String Ensemble
sketches.description: Many slightly detuned saws, slow to swell, in a wide room. Reference: a chord progression in B-flat voiced across the section.

sketches.name: Flute
sketches.description: A hollow sine with a soft attack and gentle vibrato. Reference: a G major scale up and down, then a lyrical phrase with a held top note.

sketches.name: Clarinet
sketches.description: A plain square wave, because a clarinet's tone is mostly odd harmonics, softened by a filter. Reference: the warm low register, then a run up into the clarion.

sketches.name: Oboe
sketches.description: A reedy saw through a narrow e vowel: nasal and focused. Reference: a pastoral phrase in F.

sketches.name: Tenor Saxophone
sketches.description: A reedy saw through an o vowel, gliding between notes like a breathing player. Reference: a swung blues lick in B-flat.

sketches.name: Shakuhachi
sketches.description: A breathy bamboo flute: a hollow sine with a slow attack, wide vibrato and long glides. Reference: phrases in the in scale on D.

sketches.name: Trumpet
sketches.description: A bright saw whose filter opens on every attack, like a lip buzz. Reference: a fanfare on the open notes of C, then a stepwise phrase.

sketches.name: French Horn
sketches.description: A dark saw with a slow filter swell in a large hall. Reference: a noble call in F.

sketches.name: Tuba
sketches.description: A low, round saw with a short filter blip on each note. Reference: an oom-pah bass line in B-flat.

sketches.name: Harmonica
sketches.description: A reedy saw through an o vowel with wide vibrato and quick bends. Reference: blues phrases in A.

sketches.name: Accordion
sketches.description: Two reeds tuned slightly apart (the musette wobble) through an a vowel. Reference: a waltz in A minor, melody on the right and oom-pah-pah on the left.

sketches.name: Bagpipes
sketches.description: A reedy chanter, loud and unbroken, with drones a fifth apart beneath it. Reference: a tune in A with grace notes.

sketches.name: Choir
sketches.description: The choir voice singing open vowels with a slow breath in a church. Reference: four chords, each on its own vowel.

sketches.name: Solo Soprano
sketches.description: A single voice in the soprano range, gliding from syllable to syllable. Reference: a scale sung on la, then a phrase in the singing alphabet.

sketches.name: Drum Kit
sketches.description: Every piece of the built-in kit, one per bar (kick, snare, closed and open hats, clap, rim, toms, crash and ride), then two bars of groove that use them all.

sketches.name: Timpani
sketches.description: A tuned drumhead: a low FM tone with a small pitch drop and a long hall. Reference: tonic and dominant strokes, then a roll.

sketches.name: Hand Drums
sketches.description: The kit's toms and rim tuned up and played by hand: low strokes, high slaps and finger taps, growing busier over four bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// The kit's toms and rim tuned up: low strokes on lt, slaps on ht, finger taps on the rim
reference: s("<[lt ~ [~ lt] ht] [lt ht [~ ht] ht, ~ ~ rim ~] [lt rim ~ rim lt ~ rim ~] [lt ht ht [ht ht], rim*8]>")
  .speed(1.2).room(.3).gain(.45)

sketches.name: Gong
sketches.description: A large metal plate: inharmonic FM with a little ring modulation, shimmering for many seconds. Reference: two strokes, a fifth apart.

sketches.name: Acid Bass
sketches.description: A resonant saw with a snappy filter envelope, short notes and accents. Reference: a classic sixteen-step line in A minor with a wandering cutoff.

sketches.name: 808 Sub
sketches.description: A long sine with a punchy pitch drop, some grit and glide between notes. Reference: a two-bar trap line in C minor.

sketches.name: Supersaw Lead
sketches.description: Seven detuned saws stacked into one wide, bright voice. Reference: an anthem lead in F minor.

sketches.name: Warm Pad
sketches.description: Detuned saws with slow envelopes and a filter that breathes over eight bars. Reference: four lush seventh chords.

sketches.name: Chiptune Pulse
sketches.description: A pulse wave with a quick envelope and a touch of vibrato, as on old game consoles. Reference: a melody that steps through the three classic duty cycles, 12.5%, 25% and 50%.

sketches.name: Theremin
sketches.description: A pure sine that never stops sounding, sliding slowly between notes with a wide vibrato. Reference: an eerie phrase in A minor.
